points.description: Defines a queue as a data structure that stores a collection of elements (linear data structure/container of items).
States that it follows the First In First Out (FIFO) principle: the element added first is removed first. Equivalent wording accepted.

States the main operations: enqueue (add an element at the rear/back) and dequeue (remove an element from the front). Both operations must be named or clearly described; equivalent names (e.g. add/remove, offer/poll) accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half credit (0.75) if only one of the two operations is given.
